# 地区引用与历史

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

`state(id)` 创建地区引用；省份 ID 与地区 ID 是不同层次。`StateHistory` 描述地区的初始归属、资源和建筑，`StateBuildings` 与 `ProvinceBuildings` 分别对应地区级、具体省份级设置。修改地图相关内容前，通过项目世界和地图验证核对实际 ID。

## StateHistory() { #statehistory }

> **StateHistory**(`spec`: [`StateHistorySpec`](#statehistoryspec)): [`Definition`](scope-selection.md#definition)

Defined in: [src/sdk/index.ts:505](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/index.ts#L505)

Write a complete state history file. When replacing an existing state, give its exact native path and preserve the province membership that should remain in the state.

### Parameters { #statehistory-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `spec` | [`StateHistorySpec`](#statehistoryspec) |

### Returns { #statehistory-section-returns }

[`Definition`](scope-selection.md#definition)

### Example { #statehistory-section-example }

```ts
StateHistory({ state: state(1), name: "STATE_1", owner: country("KRG"),
  manpower: 180000, category: "rural", provinces: [3838, 9851, 11804],
  buildings: { infrastructure: 2 }, path: "history/states/1-France.txt" });
```

### See { #statehistory-section-see }

[StateHistorySpec](#statehistoryspec)
